nodes.label: Rootine
nodes.summary: Expo/React Native sustainability app on Supabase. Users receive personalized environmental missions (Trilha), learn via flashcards/quizzes (Aventura), grow a tree with XP (Habitat), track audited impact (Perfil), and engage with community/news (Biosfera). Designed to run free-tier without paid AI.

nodes.label: Habitat tab (app/(tabs)/index.tsx)
nodes.summary: Tree screen. Renamed 'Habita' -> 'Habitat'. Displays TreeDisplay driven by XP level + progress within level; must have 13 visual milestones (levels 0-12) and no preview controls in production.

nodes.label: Trilha tab (app/(tabs)/adventure.tsx)
nodes.summary: Mission screen (labeled Trilha despite the 'adventure' filename). Lists/generates daily and specialized missions personalized from real user facts via mission_patterns.

nodes.label: Aventura tab (app/(tabs)/flashcards.tsx)
nodes.summary: Flashcards + quiz screen (labeled Aventura despite the 'flashcards' filename). Balanced batches of 10 cards, max 3 per category, 7-day no-repeat; feeds deterministic profile facts and capped daily XP.

nodes.label: Perfil tab (app/(tabs)/profile.tsx)
nodes.summary: Profile screen with Statistics, Achievements, History, and Cientista tabs. Target state: read real ledgers/facts for XP, impact aggregates (week/month/total), achievements, and fact correction via events.

nodes.label: Biosfera tab (app/(tabs)/biosphere.tsx)
nodes.summary: Biosphere screen: static forum, RSS news/events via biosphere-feed. Target: real community feed/challenges with RLS, achievement/impact sharing, no aggressive competitive ranking.

nodes.label: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Tab navigator. Final labels: index->Habitat, adventure->Trilha, flashcards->Aventura, profile->Perfil, biosphere->Biosfera; admin/explore/missions hidden with href: null.

nodes.label: store/useEcoStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store controlling profile, missions, completion, refusal, manual failure, feedback, and editing. Generic local mission fallback removed; failures/refusals feed sync-user-brain. Mission updates always filter by id and user_id; feedback_notes stored as JSON {text, source, created_at}.

nodes.label: store/useFlashcardStore.ts
nodes.summary: Store for flashcard batches. Selection depends on generate-batch; answers feed deterministic facts/events without AI.

nodes.label: app/diagnostic/index.tsx (onboarding)
nodes.summary: Onboarding flow, refactored (Prompt 4) to 12-14 closed questions covering housing, water/energy control, mobility, time, money, health/safety limits, experience, and goals. Produces >=8 useful facts without AI.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/generate-missions
nodes.summary: Builds MissionGenerationContextV1, filters/ranks mission_patterns deterministically (hard blocks, cost, time, difficulty, history, diversity), optionally invokes the AI Mission Composer for 2-3 candidates, validates each with validateMissionCandidate + action_fingerprint + semantic anti-repetition, falls back to contextual pattern text without AI, and writes mission_generation_logs.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/edit-mission
nodes.summary: Safe mission editing (Prompt 8): classifies feedback into a validated schema (issue_type, constraint_strength, blocked_actions...), treats feedback as constraint not literal goal, re-validates the edited mission (impact, effort, cost, difficulty, used_fact_keys, pattern_key, edit_snapshot), never writes learned_preferences via AI, conservative fallback when classification fails.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/sync-user-brain
nodes.summary: Deterministic aggregator (no AI writes to profile). Processes BATCH_COMPLETED, QUIZ_COMPLETED, MISSION_ACTION (completed/refused/failed), FEEDBACK_SENT. refused -> preference, priority_delta -0.1; failed -> constraint, priority_delta -0.06, lower difficulty; neither creates hard blocks. Rewrites versioned caches learned_preferences/affinities/socioeconomic_context traceable to user_profile_events.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/generate-batch
nodes.summary: Selects balanced flashcard batches (10 cards, max 3 per category, 7-day no-repeat) using metadata and history — not pure random shuffle.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/generate-quiz
nodes.summary: Deterministic quiz selection from the quiz_questions catalog; AI optional and never source of truth.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/habitat-leaves
nodes.summary: Generates narrative tree messages via AI/cache; may narrate but never decides XP or level.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/profile-scientist-chat
nodes.summary: Cientista chat: AI with fallback, read-only over facts/summaries, JWT validation, per-user rate limit, educational disclaimer, summarized context only (no raw sensitive history to AI or logs).

nodes.label: supabase/functions/biosphere-feed
nodes.summary: Fetches external RSS news/events. Contains no personal data, so it may remain public without JWT.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/_shared/agents.ts
nodes.summary: Shared agent layer: agents, categories, and interaction logging used by AI-capable functions.

nodes.label: supabase/functions/_shared/supabase-admin.ts
nodes.summary: Creates the service-role client; extended (Prompt 1) with a shared helper that validates Authorization/JWT and compares requestedUserId with the authenticated user before any service-role action.

nodes.label: lib/domain (shared domain layer)
nodes.summary: Pure modules (categories, xp, missions, profile, impact, validation, facts) with mandatory validators: validateMissionCandidate, validateMissionPersonalization, validateEnvironmentalGoal, validateFeedbackClassification, validateImpactEstimate, validateProfileFact, getLevelFromXp, getMissionXpReward. Blocks generic missions, missing used_fact_keys, schema drift (e.g. 'déficit' vs 'deficit'), and invented categories.

nodes.label: ddl.sql
nodes.summary: Local schema record; partially outdated (still lists pending/expired mission statuses that must be treated as failed). All new table/field changes appended at the end. Real Supabase DB screenshot is the source of truth when they diverge.

nodes.label: add.sql
nodes.summary: Executable Supabase scripts appended at the end: RLS, policies, SQL functions, triggers, seeds (>=84 mission_patterns, >=96 flashcards, >=60 quiz_questions, >=12 achievements), and backfills.

nodes.label: user_missions
nodes.summary: Missions per user. Real statuses: active, completed, refused, failed (expired missions become failed). Extended with category, environmental_goal, difficulty, effort_minutes, cost_level, xp_reward, used_fact_keys, personalization_reason, generation_snapshot, expected_impact, impact_logged_at, pattern_key, action_fingerprint.

nodes.label: user_profile_events
nodes.summary: Immutable event log: onboarding answers, Aventura/Trilha actions, feedback, XP, and profile corrections. Corrections are new events; raw history is never silently edited.

nodes.label: user_profile_facts
nodes.summary: Derived facts with fact_key, fact_type, category, value, confidence, source_event_ids, active. Derived deterministically (never by AI); normalized vocabulary prevents schema drift.

nodes.label: xp_ledger
nodes.summary: Idempotent XP entries with source_type, source_id, idempotency_key. profiles.xp is a derived cache. Rewards: difficulty 1-5 -> 10/16/25/40/60 XP; batch >=70% -> 4 XP; correct quiz -> 2 XP (8 XP daily cap); achievements 15-80 XP; refused/failed/edited -> 0 XP.

nodes.label: impact_ledger
nodes.summary: Idempotent impact rows per completed mission referencing mission_id, pattern_key, impact_model_key, model_version; marks estimated vs user-reported; aggregated weekly/monthly/total in Perfil with low/mid/high + confidence intervals (water_l, co2_kg, waste_g, energy_kwh).

nodes.label: mission_patterns
nodes.summary: Catalog of >=84 validated environmental mechanisms (14 per category with fixed difficulty distribution 4/4/3/2/1). Each has key, category, environmental_goal, difficulty range, cost_level, effort range, required/disqualifying fact types, >=4 personalization_slots, action_fingerprint, impact_model_key, and Portuguese fallback text. Blueprints, not final templates.

nodes.label: mission_generation_logs
nodes.summary: Audit of generation/ranking/validation: ai_used, ai_stage, ai_provider, ai_model, fallback_reason, candidate_count, selected_pattern_key, selected_action_fingerprint, rejected candidates and reasons.

nodes.label: quiz_questions
nodes.summary: Reusable quiz catalog: >=60 active (10 per category), each with 4 alternatives, 1 correct, short explanation, difficulty 1-5. Replaces the legacy quizzes table flow (Prompt 5).

nodes.label: flashcards
nodes.summary: Extended with category, signal_key, signal_type, true_effect, false_effect, skip_effect, weight, difficulty, active. Minimum 96 active (16 per category: 8 habits, 4 restrictions/capabilities, 4 preferences). Skip creates no deficit or hard block.

nodes.label: achievement_definitions / user_achievements
nodes.summary: Achievement catalog (>=12 active: first mission, 5/20 missions, first Aventura, 7-day streak, 4 categories, first edit, difficulty 3/4 missions, water/waste/CO2 impact) and per-user idempotent unlocks.

nodes.label: profiles
nodes.summary: User profile with nome (kept for compatibility), xp (cache derived from xp_ledger), socioeconomic_context snapshot, and versioned deterministic caches learned_preferences and affinities.

nodes.label: AI Mission Composer
nodes.summary: Optional AI stage in generate-missions: receives safe pattern blueprints + summarized profile context, proposes 2-3 genuinely adapted mission candidates. May explore form/moment/object/approach but never invents facts, hard blocks, canonical category, impact, XP, cost, or difficulty. Every candidate must pass validateMissionCandidate, fingerprint, and anti-repetition checks; on failure the deterministic contextual fallback is used with ai_used:false logged.

nodes.label: MissionGenerationContextV1
nodes.summary: Context object assembled before ranking: facts, constraints, history, refusals, failures, impact, and diversity signals.

nodes.label: action_fingerprint
nodes.summary: Canonical action identity (e.g. waste.clean_recyclables, energy.turn_off_idle_lights) used with semantic similarity, used_fact_keys overlap, and per-pattern/fingerprint/category cooldowns to block missions that differ in text but are the same in practice, especially after refused/failed.

nodes.label: XP curve and levels
nodes.summary: 13 levels (0 Semente ... 12 Referência sustentável) at thresholds 0/10/45/100/180/300/470/700/1000/1400/1900/2500/3200 XP; beyond 12: xp_next = xp_current + round(700 + (level-12)*180). Habitat progress = (xp - xp_min_level)/(xp_next_level - xp_min_level); TreeDisplay must not use xp/120.

nodes.label: AI-optional architecture
nodes.summary: Main flow works without AI. Secrets (GROQ_API_KEY/GROQ_MODEL or OPEN_AI_KEY/OPENAI_MODEL) enable AI in generate-missions, edit-mission, habitat-leaves, profile-scientist-chat. When AI is off/failing/rejected: contextual pattern fallback for generation, conservative edit fallback, canned habitat/scientist replies; logs always record ai_used:false and fallback_reason. No AI keys in EXPO_PUBLIC_* vars.

nodes.label: Structured log prefixes
nodes.summary: [AUTH] [NAV] [ONBOARDING] [AVENTURA]/[ADVENTURE] [TRILHA] [BRAIN] [MISSION_GEN] [MISSION_EDIT] [XP] [IMPACT] [HABITAT] [PROFILE] [SCIENTIST] [BIOSPHERE] [RLS]. Logs never expose tokens, emails, JWTs, service role keys, full prompts, or detailed medical data; AI flows must log ai_used, ai_stage, ai_provider, ai_model, fallback_reason, validation_status.

nodes.label: RLS and JWT security model
nodes.summary: Users only read/write their own events, facts, missions, XP, impact, achievements, leaves, and answers. Active catalogs readable by authenticated users. Sensitive writes go through Edge Functions/service role or secure RPCs. verify_jwt=true on every function receiving userId (all except biosphere-feed); requestedUserId compared against JWT identity via the shared helper.

nodes.label: Roadmap: Prompts 1-11
nodes.summary: Ordered implementation prompts: 1 navigation+security, 2 DB+RLS, 3 domain validators+fixtures, 4 rich onboarding, 5 deterministic Aventura, 6 deterministic brain, 7 hyper-personalized Trilha, 8 safe editing, 9 XP/impact/achievements/Habitat, 10 Perfil/Cientista/Biosfera+final validation, 11 hardening/observability. Debug checkpoints 1-10 in roteiro-debug-manual.md validate each block.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (graphify project rules)
nodes.summary: Project instructions: use graphify query/path/explain against graphify-out/graph.json for codebase questions, use the wiki for navigation, read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad review, and run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: README (Expo starter)
nodes.summary: Default create-expo-app README for the Rootine project: npm install, npx expo start, file-based routing in the app/ directory, reset-project script, and Expo community links.

nodes.label: Estratégia de implementação do Rootine
nodes.summary: Source of truth for the Rootine roadmap: 11 implementation prompts covering navigation/security, database + RLS, shared domain validators, rich onboarding, deterministic Aventura (flashcards/quizzes), deterministic user brain, hyper-personalized Trilha missions via mission_patterns + AI Mission Composer, safe mission editing, XP/impact/achievements/Habitat, Perfil/Cientista/Biosfera, and hardening/observability. Core principle: the main flow must work without paid AI; AI improves text but is never the source of truth for user facts, impact, XP, or category.

nodes.label: Roteiro de debug manual do Rootine
nodes.summary: Manual test script with 10 checkpoints mapped to the roadmap prompts of estrategia-rootine.md. Defines two test personas (user_a beginner, user_b experienced), the standard log prefixes ([AUTH], [NAV], [RLS], [MISSION_GEN], [XP], etc.), per-checkpoint step-by-step validations across App/Expo, Edge Function logs, and database rows, plus a list of red-flag conditions that block progression.
